svg.aria-label: GraphLab synthetic context and expressivity audit

g.text: GraphLab | context is part of the model
96 synthetic nodes, 483 undirected edges. 16 gradient labels + 16 validation labels; 64 test labels withheld.
Fill = true class. Black outline = gradient label. Red ring = GCN test error.
Positions use known classes for a schematic, not a learned embedding.
Validation CE selects independently; final checkpoints also reported.
An exact limitation: a cycle is not two triangles
produce identical node probabilities in this GCN.
Maximum difference: 0.0 on the exact fixture.
Permutation equivariance is not graph distinguishability.
Transductive development fixture: every node feature and edge is visible. This is not unseen-graph evaluation.
Edges were generated from class communities. No causal-component, real-data or general model-ranking claim.
